tool.name: go-dork
tool.description: Fast Google/Bing/Shodan dork scanner for Google-hacking queries (exposed files, panels, info). STRATEGY: prefer the built-in brave_search tool for Google dorking (API-backed, reliable) - go-dork is a free scraping fallback that Google frequently rate-limits and OFTEN RETURNS EMPTY RESULTS SILENTLY when blocked. Treat an empty or errored go-dork run as 'blocked, not done' and re-run the same dork query via brave_search before concluding checked-empty. See the dork-strategy skill doc.

params.label: Proxy
params.description: HTTP proxy (strongly recommended - Google blocks scraping)

skills.name: Site dork (Google)
skills.description: Run a Google dork against a target. Use a proxy to avoid blocking.

skills.name: Exposed files on domain
skills.description: Find indexable/exposed files on a domain.
skills.args: -q "site:{{domain}} (ext:sql OR ext:env OR ext:bak OR intitle:index.of)" -e google -p 3
